quests.name: Act 10 • Epilogue boss field notes
quests.description: Current Epilogue boss preparation. This section separates the Act 10.4.4 Chronoserpent from the earlier Act 9.4.6 Carina encounter and does not claim full path coverage.

bosses.name: The Chronoserpent
bosses.summary: A 20-health-bar finale built around Vigor management, Major and Minor Modes, changing Special Attack timing, and a final knockout condition.

phases.name: Core loop — build and preserve Vigor
phases.text: Interrupt Basic Attacks, punish Heavy Attacks, and punish Special Attacks to gain personal Vigor Passives. Hitting the Chronoserpent or his Block refreshes Vigor. The fight is tuned around using Vigor for damage rather than relying on ordinary output.

phases.name: Phase 1 • 20–17 bars
phases.text: Track Major and Minor Mode. He changes Mode whenever a Health Bar is depleted. Major Mode raises Combat Power Rate; Minor Mode makes him more aggressive and increases Block Penetration.

phases.name: Phase 2 • 16–13 bars
phases.text: Special Attack timing begins changing with Mode. Learn both tempos instead of using one fixed Dexterity rhythm.

phases.name: Phase 3 • 12–9 bars
phases.text: Blocking Special Attack hits can unpause your Vigor. Major Mode changes his reaction during later hits of your Basic Attack combo, while Minor Mode can remove your ability to Block or trigger Reversal against Combo-Opening Attacks.

phases.name: Phase 4 • 8–5 bars
phases.text: Your Special Attacks can change his Mode. Special Attack 1 can apply Corrosion, and Special Attack 2 can apply Wound of Defiance through Block. Keep enough space to dodge rather than treating Block as the safe answer.

phases.name: Phase 5 • 4–1 bars
phases.text: Interrupting his Medium or Heavy Attacks changes Mode, and his Special Attacks move faster. Re-check the current Mode before every Special Attack 2 directional input.

phases.name: Phase 6 • final bar below 50%
phases.text: Time flow randomly changes after the first hit of an attack and determines Major or Minor Mode. To knock him out, land a Special Attack while you have more than one personal Vigor.

mistakes: Spending every Vigor window on Basic Attacks instead of preserving a strong Special Attack damage window.
Using the same Special Attack dodge timing after Phase 2 changes the tempo.
Choosing the wrong swipe direction during Special Attack 2: Major Mode calls for swipe up after the third claw hit, while Minor Mode calls for swipe down.
Trying to finish the final Health Bar without more than one personal Vigor.
bosses.avoid: Do not build a plan around Stun, Sleep or Power-gain prevention; the Chronoserpent is immune to those control effects. Prefer Champions whose damage or sustain scales well during Vigor windows and whose rotation leaves room to punish Special Attacks.

guideDetails.statusNote: Official ability text is the primary mechanics source. Community Champion reports are presented as options, not as a ranked tier list or guaranteed solo list.
attackerProfile: A rotation that can punish Special Attacks consistently, because Special Attack punishes build multiple Vigor stacks.
Strong Special Attack damage or damage-over-time that can exploit Vigor-enhanced windows.
Sustain is valuable because the encounter spans 20 Health Bars and later phases add Corrosion, Wound of Defiance and faster Special Attacks.
Do not require Stun, Sleep or Power Lock as the core control plan.

cheatSheet.watch: Major = more Combat Power Rate; Minor = aggression and Block Penetration

cheatSheet.objective: Protect Vigor and manage combo restrictions
cheatSheet.watch: Blocking Special hits can unpause Vigor

cheatSheet.objective: Respect Corrosion and Wound of Defiance
cheatSheet.watch: Special Attack 2 damage can trigger through Block

cheatSheet.objective: Finish with a Special Attack at 2+ Vigor
cheatSheet.watch: Time flow replaces earlier Mode-change rules

preparation: Practice Special Attack 2 with both directional inputs before committing resources: swipe up after the third claw hit in Major Mode, swipe down in Minor Mode.
Treat every four depleted Health Bars as a new mechanics checkpoint. A new Phase also creates a short period where he cannot take damage and you cannot gain Power.
Punishing Special Attacks is the fastest route to multiple Vigor stacks; Heavy punishes and intercepts are useful when the Special Attack pattern is unsafe.

troubleshooting.response: Rebuild Vigor. The encounter heavily rewards Vigor windows, while the Chronoserpent also suppresses most Attribute changes from their starting values.
Confirm the current Mode before the third claw hit. Use the Mode-specific vertical swipe; the wrong direction makes the final beam unavoidable.

troubleshooting.problem: The last hit will not knock him out
troubleshooting.response: The final phase requires a Special Attack while more than one personal Vigor is active. A normal Basic Attack finish is not sufficient.

verification.note: Core mechanics are based on Kabam's published Chronoserpent ability page. Champion options come from current player reports and are not independent gameplay tests by this site.

counters.why: Players report Chee'ilth as a strong Skill option because her Bleed damage and Special Attack output scale well once Vigor is active.
counters.strategy: Build Vigor through interrupts and Special Attack punishes, then use the Vigor window for Special Attack damage while maintaining safe spacing.
counters.risks: Later phases speed up Specials and add Mode-dependent rules; damage does not replace the need to read Major/Minor Mode.
counters.scoreReason: Community-supported boss option with relevant fight fit; not independently gameplay-tested by this site.
conditions: Keep multiple Vigor stacks for major damage windows.

counters.why: Multiple players report Doctor Strange as an effective Mystic option, with sustain and Special Attack 1 damage benefiting from Vigor.
counters.strategy: Punish Specials to stack Vigor, then cycle Special Attack 1 during strong windows while preserving enough space for the next Mode-dependent Special.
counters.risks: Later Corrosion and Wound of Defiance still punish mistakes; sustain is not immunity.
counters.scoreReason: Community-supported boss option with relevant fight fit; not independently gameplay-tested by this site.
conditions: Use Vigor as the damage engine.
Do not rely on Stun or Power-gain prevention.

counters.why: Community reports identify Ironheart as a strong Tech option whose damage-over-time can continue contributing while the player manages the boss mechanics.
counters.strategy: Build Vigor first, then align Ironheart's Special Attack damage and damaging effects with the strongest Vigor windows.
counters.risks: The encounter's Attribute-change suppression and Mode rules still apply; do not evaluate the matchup only from normal quest damage.
counters.scoreReason: Community-supported boss option with relevant fight fit; not independently gameplay-tested by this site.
conditions: Punish Special Attacks to stack Vigor.

counters.why: Jean Grey is repeatedly mentioned in current community reports as a strong Mutant option for the Chronoserpent.
counters.strategy: Use a mechanics-first approach: build Vigor, preserve it through safe refreshes, and spend the amplified window on Special Attacks.
counters.risks: The final phase still requires more than one personal Vigor for the knockout.
counters.scoreReason: Community-supported boss option with relevant fight fit; not independently gameplay-tested by this site.
conditions: Finish the last phase with a Special Attack while 2+ Vigor are active.

counters.why: Kushala is reported as a solid Mystic option, combining sustained damage with a rotation that can exploit Vigor windows.
counters.strategy: Use Special Attack punishes to build Vigor, then line up Kushala's damage cycle without sacrificing the spacing needed for the next boss Special.
counters.risks: Stun and Power-gain prevention are not valid control plans against this boss.
counters.scoreReason: Community-supported boss option with relevant fight fit; not independently gameplay-tested by this site.
conditions: Do not over-refresh Vigor if the accelerated expiry will waste the stack.
